text:
mike: Thinking about a Friday LAN night at the office? Steam sale has some stupid deals and I miss actually yelling at people over lag. Anyone in?

sara: In! I can bring Switch + Smash, and maybe some USB hubs.

raj: I can bring my rig and host a CS2 lobby or Valheim server. What time were you thinking?

olivia: CS2 + Smash = chaos, love it. Also FYI steam sale link: https://store.steampowered.com/sale — some good indie bundles rn.

taylor: Sat works better for me, Friday I'm out late.

zoe: Quick poll — react with :one: for Friday, :two: for Saturday. Also do we want competitive or chill vibes?

sam: :one: for Friday. Chill for me, but I can queue for some ranked later.

mike: Cool — leaning Fri 7pm then. Room idea: Conference B has power strips and a projector.

raj: If it's Valheim/CS2 I'll set up a headless Linux box. Paste config below: ```ssh raj@lan-host.local
# start cs2 server
./cs2_server --map de_dust2 --maxplayers 10```

sara: Bringing snacks + spare controllers. Anyone allergic to peanuts?

zoe: Not me. Also I can grab a couple extra ethernet cables.

olivia: Can someone put up a quick doodle for who brings what? Otherwise I'll just assume Mike orders pizza. :pizza: :thumbsup:

mike: I'll order pizza and mark dietary prefs. Also added a short wishlist: Rocket League, Smash, CS2, Valheim. If anyone wants to host indie LAN-only stuff DM me.

sam: nice. count me in for Friday 7.

raj: Count me in too. I'll post server IP in the thread before we start.

zoe: done — created a tiny poll msg in #random-polls for visibility.

mike: Perfect. See you all Friday. Real talk: whoever brings the best snack gets MVP. :crown:
